mr_title: Fail on slider tail miss option in Sudden Death
mr_description:
- Fail on slider tail miss option in Sudden Death
- Rename to PFC mode

expected_issues.title: The current implementation only fails on HitResult.IgnoreMiss for slider tails
expected_issues.description: The current implementation only fails on HitResult.IgnoreMiss for slider tails. Consider aligning with the existing OsuHealthProcessor logic which treats any non-hit (!result.IsHit) on slider tails as significant. This ensures consistency and prevents unexpected behavior where certain types of slider tail misses might not trigger sudden death.

expected_issues.description: The `FailCondition` override duplicates the base class failure logic instead of calling `base.FailCondition`, creating unnecessary code duplication and maintenance risk. Replace the custom implementation `result.Type.AffectsCombo() && !result.IsHit` with `base.FailCondition(healthProcessor, result)`.
